STAGE: workspace-inspection (ideation_2)
GOAL: find the frozen baseline code, the RQ-VAE SID construction and the failure numbers the round refers to, before proposing anything.
READ: working directory listing of .../rounds/round_20261031_101346_116/agents/ideation_2 (session.jsonl, progress.jsonl, running.json, opencode.json, stderr.log only); attempted reads of /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec and .../research/121 were refused (permission denied: external_directory); glob of /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/* returned no files.
OBSERVED: no repository, no Stage-2 config, no Stage-3 protocol file and no baseline recall is readable from this sandbox. The only inputs available are the round brief text and the measured history it quotes (round_20261028_233100_128, round_20261029_030015_260, round_20261029_093253_576: all selected ideas were curved codebook/curvature-control/radial-assignment variants, all probes NOT_RUN, no recall number recorded).
EVIDENCE: tool output in this session; the three earlier selected ids are quoted in the brief itself (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ).
REASONING: cannot ground the proposal in read code, so the design must be specified self-containedly and must avoid the three occupied positions: (a) successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates, (b) per-prefix-level curvature control, (c) context-entropy radial assignment. The brief's own failure statement ("a move or assignment may only be taken when it does NOT increase the number of cross-cell neighbour pairs whose behaviour is disjoint") points at a discrete assignment-repair position, which none of the three occupied positions uses.
OPEN: whether the baseline L1 negative-hit rate is actually large enough for a repair to bite; whether cell sizes dominate it. Proposal must carry a pre-registered kill condition for that.

STAGE: full-answer (summary)
GOAL: deliver the single proposal as the task's last record.
WHAT IT PROPOSES: HEXSWAP-SID, a size-preserving exchange repair of the level-1 RQ-VAE token, applied once after Stage-2 epoch 3000 and before SIDs are frozen. Curvature K = 1/(4 delta_hat^2) with delta_hat the measured Gromov delta of the training transition graph; Lorentz exp maps, Lorentz distance and geodesic-Voronoi cell adjacency; behaviour term lambda_ij = ln((W_ij+alpha)/(d_i d_j/(2M)+alpha)) from training-only transitions; bound tau = quantile at 1 - h1_train of the baseline same-L1 pair log-ratios, h1_train being the baseline train-split L1 negative hit rate. Accept an exchange only if lambda_{i,b} - sqrt(K)*max(0, m_L(i;a,b)) > tau and the lexicographic potential (number of behaviour-disjoint geodesically adjacent cell pairs, number of behaviour-disjoint same-cell pairs) strictly decreases; each item exchanged at most once; residuals of moved items re-quantized, all unmoved rows byte-identical, L1 cell sizes invariant.
WHY IN SCOPE: one inequality carries both the behaviour term and the curved term; the same curved operator defines the adjacency whose disjointness count is the potential; behaviour-off and geometry-off switches exist as pure hyperbol ic re-assignment and pure Euclidean-margin variants; no ablation, sweep or multi-seed run is needed; leakage is bounded by estimating W, alpha, delta_hat, K and tau from the training split only.
COST: 0 added per-step cost over 72000 Stage-2 steps; one post-hoc pass of order 3.2e9 flops for adjacency plus about 1.5e5 candidate evaluations, under one minute wall clock, under 0.5 percent of the run.
KILL CONDITIONS: baseline h1_train below 0.02, or fewer than 100 items where the Lorentz nearest codeword differs from the RQ-VAE codeword (geometry inert).
EVIDENCE: this record; full text printed in the response.
OPEN: same as above, empirical only.
